description: The bar chart illustrates the retrieval performance, measured by MAP@10, for two different sampling strategies—Fine-to-Coarse Sampling Strategy (purple bars) and Uniform Sampling Strategy (yellow bars)—across varying values of m, which ranges from 6 to 10 on the horizontal axis. The vertical axis represents the MAP@10 score, scaled from 23.0 to 27.0 in increments of 0.5. For each value of m, two bars are displayed side-by-side, with the Fine-to-Coarse strategy consistently achieving higher MAP@10 scores than the Uniform strategy. The highest MAP@10 value, approximately 26.75, is observed for the Fine-to-Coarse strategy at m = 7, while the lowest value, around 24.35, is for the Uniform strategy at m = 6. The legend in the top right corner identifies the color coding for the two strategies.
